core_obligations: Assume underline{S'} subset G subset underline{S} and S' = G_{\\overline{eta}} (proof line 12695): because eta is in the image of every etale U -> X with U nonempty (proof line 12696), the stalk of G at the generic point is the restriction of S' to U.

Conclude G = underline{S'} (proof line 12697): the same density argument identifies the stalk of G over every etale U -> X with that of underline{S'}, and the three cases (sets, abelian groups, modules) differ only in the ambient category.
proof_roadmap: The single step is the density of eta in the image of every nonempty etale neighbourhood.
Coupling underline{S'} subset G with the stalk equality over eta forces G to agree with underline{S'} over every etale neighbourhood U -> X.
difficulty_reason: The lemma pins down the constant subsheaves of a constant sheaf on the etale site of an irreducible scheme, in the set, abelian group and module cases (statement lines 12674-12692). The proof is one line (proof lines 12694-12697): the hypothesis fixes the stalk of G at the generic point eta as S', and since every etale morphism U -> X with U nonempty contains eta in its image, the stalk of G over U is the same copy of S' over U; hence G equals underline{S'} throughout. H2: a single density fact drives the three cases.
